stations.name: Altadena
stations.note: Drill site at the edge of the boxwork unit, June 2025. The powdered sample went to CheMin and SAM; the drill hole walls change tone with depth.

stations.name: Laguna Escondida and Laguna Socompa
stations.note: Parked between two hollows while looking for a drill site, Sept. 2025. Six contact-science targets on the ridge tops that week.

stations.name: Monte Grande hollow
stations.note: Drill site "Valle de la Luna" inside the Monte Grande hollow, Oct. 2025: the hollow half of a ridge and hollow pair.

stations.name: Nevado Sajama ridge
stations.note: Drill site on top of the ridge beside Monte Grande, Nov. 2025: Curiosity's 45th drill hole and the ridge half of the pair.

stations.name: Polygons in the hollow
stations.note: Polygonal textures in a hollow, Dec. 2025.

stations.name: Conjunction ridge
stations.note: Parked on a ridge for solar conjunction, Dec. 27, 2025 to Jan. 20, 2026, after a chemistry and imaging transect of the ridge wall between the two drill holes.

stations.name: Tapiche hollow
stations.note: Parked in the Tapiche hollow with the Los Flamencos ridge to the south, Feb. 2026, on the way to the boxwork's eastern contact.

stations.name: Southern contact
stations.note: Just over the southernmost contact of the boxwork with the layered sulfate unit, March 2026: Curiosity's third crossing of that contact.

stations.name: Antofagasta crater and Atacama
stations.note: Rim of the 10 m Antofagasta crater, its floor filled with rippled sand, April 2026; then the Atacama drill campaign in the layered sulfate rock above the boxwork.

stations.name: Campo Marte
stations.note: Drill site on a thicker block of the same layered sulfate stratum as Atacama, May 2026. Nearby blocks carry a polygonal texture.

spaceWeather.source: NASA DONKI (CCMC): WSA-ENLIL simulations and SEP events
